# apple_app_store_version_phased_release (Resource)

Releases an App Store version's automatic update in phases over seven days. Create it before the version is released; the phased release starts when the version is. Destroying the resource removes the phased release before it starts, and otherwise leaves it. Import it by version ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "apple_app_store_version_phased_release" "ios" {
  version_id = apple_app_store_version.ios.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `version_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the App Store version, e.g. `apple_app_store_version.example.id`.

### Optional

- `paused` (Boolean) Whether the phased release is paused. It takes effect once the release has started, and a release can be paused for up to 30 days in total. Defaults to `false`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the phased release.
- `state` (String) State of the phased release: `INACTIVE` until the version is released, then `ACTIVE`, `PAUSED` or `COMPLETE`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = apple_app_store_version_phased_release.ios
  identity = {
    version_id = "1234567890"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `version_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the App Store version.

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import apple_app_store_version_phased_release.ios 1234567890
```
